conditions: Terms §5.7 requires prior written KOVAR authorization for standalone downstream resale/sublicensing/redistribution; §6.1 says API keys are personal, account-specific and nontransferable. Obtain an executed agreement that clearly supersedes or scopes these provisions for Vrooli's product.

Product Handbook supports partner distribution/white label but says it is not a binding offer; channel rebates and special terms are separate internal policy/approved arrangements. The published Terms contain unresolved placeholders and corrupt billing text; get a corrected, complete authoritative agreement before any eligibility.

Record KOVAR as gateway/contract supplier; its terms name Anthropic/other model providers, but actual serving provider by route and publisher/license are distinct. Verify provider rights and exact model/route scope for each model.

Public model rates/90%-of-official positioning are a retail anchor only, not partner wholesale quote. Verify current catalog, account-level availability, limits, data/trust, support and any contractual SLA.
Provider agreement, provider rule, model scope, trust and Vrooli customer price remain separate human decisions.
plan_rules.clause: KOVAR Terms §§1, 4, 5.7, 6.1, 6.3–6.4, 8.4, 10.1; Product Handbook disclaimer and partner scope
plan_rules.reason: Official handbook describes partner-distributed and white-label routes, but says it is nonbinding; standard Terms require prior written reseller authorization and contain unresolved template placeholders. Conditional candidate only.

evidence.document_date: Terms effective/last updated 2026-03-25; Handbook no visible date
